headline: Nvidia faces a China chip-diversion probe, Anthropic's IPO may price above range, CD Projekt cleans up at the Golden Joysticks, and UFC 334 media day sets up Saturday at MSG.

upcoming.what: SpaceX Starship Flight 15 (NET), booster and ship catch attempt; FAA approval still not confirmed, so the date may slip
UFC 334, Madison Square Garden: Gane vs Hokit (heavyweight title), Harrison vs Nunes. Main card about 02:00 Sun 15 Nov Irish time (TBC). PFL Dubai the same day
Leonid meteor shower peak; best after midnight once the Moon has set
GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S (console only)
Polaris 40, Southampton (Tonon vs McNally); UFC Doha: Prochazka vs Stirling; KSW 123, Szczecin
F1 Las Vegas GP, lights out around 04:00 Irish time (Sat night local)

items.headline: Nvidia hit by China chip-diversion reports
items.summary: Reuters reports a PLA-linked Chinese university obtained blacklisted H200 chips, and Nvidia's board is probing a separate report of large-scale chip diversion to China. Shares fell around 5% and political pressure on leadership is mounting.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO: demand may push pricing above range
items.summary: Following yesterday's $70-78 range, the FT reports bankers are weighing pricing above it on heavy demand, which would lift the valuation towards $1.5 trillion. The roadshow is under way ahead of a Nasdaq listing as ANT.

items.headline: Google opens up Gemini 4 Carbon
items.summary: Google's new frontier model for coding, research and agent tasks is now available to paid API developers and AI Ultra subscribers, alongside a preview of /swarm for coordinating multiple coding agents.

items.headline: Railway breach leads to $740k in fraudulent AI usage
items.summary: The cloud host says attackers grabbed customer secrets potentially touching up to 100,000 workspaces (worst-case estimate), and stolen API keys racked up roughly $740,000 in AI charges. A reminder to rotate keys and set spend caps.

items.headline: NASA lays out a faster path back to the Moon
items.summary: Artemis III becomes a 2027 Earth-orbit test docking Orion with both Blue Origin's and SpaceX's landers, with the crewed landing moving to Artemis IV in 2028. A lighter Axiom suit is also in the works.

items.headline: Starship Flight 15 still waiting on the FAA
items.summary: Booster 22 and Ship 42 are through final checks for a no-earlier-than 13 November dual-catch attempt, but there's still no public FAA sign-off. Otherwise a quiet 48 hours for space news.

items.headline: Tonight in Cavan: moonless dark, cloud unknown
items.summary: A thin crescent Moon sets early, so it's properly dark from about 18:30 after a 16:40ish sunset. A live cloud forecast couldn't be retrieved this morning, so check Met Éireann before heading out. Verdict: mixed, best window 19:00-midnight if it clears.

items.headline: Watchlist: CD Projekt cleans up at the Golden Joysticks
items.summary: The Witcher 4 won Most Wanted Game and The Witcher 3 Remastered took the most awards of the night. Separately, CDPR confirmed AI-assisted work on Geralt's Polish voice in Songs of the Past, done with the original actor's approval.

items.headline: PS5 passes 100 million consoles
items.summary: Sony says the PS5 crossed 100 million units sold as of 10 November, a week before GTA 6 lands.

items.headline: Ocarina of Time remake sells 5.2M in four days
items.summary: Nintendo's Switch 2 remake has reportedly become one of the fastest-selling Zelda launches ever.

items.headline: GTA 6 still on for 19 November
items.summary: No sign of a slip: the console launch is a week out, with no PC date yet. Nothing new on Cyberpunk 2 or Borderlands.

items.headline: Still quiet ahead of Polaris 40
items.summary: No major results this week; the next big date is Polaris 40 in Southampton on 21 November, headlined by Garry Tonon.

items.headline: UFC 334 media day: Harrison hints the end is near
items.summary: Kayla Harrison says she's close to the end of her career ahead of Saturday's long-awaited first fight with Amanda Nunes, who plans to defend at least once if she wins. Harrison is a modest favourite.

items.headline: Gane plays down the Hokit trash talk
items.summary: The champ called Hokit's act clownish but credited him as smart. Also on the card: Borralho vs Belgaroui and Holland vs Medic, with Holland saying his new deal will be his last. No Irish or UK fighters spotted on the main card.

items.headline: Dvalishvili bloodied in Abu Dhabi hotel brawl
items.summary: Merab Dvalishvili was reportedly caught up in a hotel scuffle involving Usman Nurmagomedov in Abu Dhabi.

items.headline: F1 confirms the finale stays in Qatar and Abu Dhabi
items.summary: The last two rounds go ahead on 29 November and 6 December, with Imola dropped as a backup, though F1 kept the option to cancel if the regional situation worsens. Antonelli has already sealed the drivers' title.

items.headline: Haas weighs Camara, Hirakawa or Doohan for Vegas
items.summary: Rafael Camara, who debuted in Brazil after Ocon's exit, says he's open to racing the rest of 2026 before his full 2027 seat. Hirakawa, fresh from his WEC Hypercar title, is also in the frame.

items.headline: Ferrari explains Hamilton's 65-place grid penalty
items.summary: Hamilton was already facing a 10-place drop after his car smoked in FP3 at Interlagos; Ferrari has now explained the bigger call behind the 65-place penalty.
